name: gizza-ai/latex-to-mathml
summary: Convert a LaTeX math expression to MathML markup.

tool.description: Convert a LaTeX math expression into MathML markup (a <math> element). Accessible, selectable and reusable in HTML, EPUB and Office documents. Supports fractions, roots, super/subscripts, Greek letters, big operators, delimiters and matrices; block or inline display; optional pretty-print.
